outcome: Renal involvement in newborns with urinary tract infection (UTI)
cohort: The study included 117 newborns with a gestational age greater than 35 weeks who were hospitalized in the NICU for urinary tract infection.
finding: The systemic immune-inflammation index (SII), along with CRP, IL-6, PLR, and NLR, demonstrated predictive ability for discriminating renal involvement from normal renal findings in newborns with UTIs.
